steps.en: Add the library to your front-end (or Node) project
steps.zh: 把库加进前端（或 Node）项目

steps.en: Create a document; default is A4 portrait in millimetres
steps.zh: 新建文档，默认 A4 纵向、单位毫米

steps.en: Place text, images and shapes at explicit x/y positions
steps.zh: 按 x/y 坐标放文字、图片和图形

steps.en: Encodes fonts, images and vectors into PDF objects in memory
steps.zh: 在内存里把字体、图片、矢量编码成 PDF 对象

steps.en: Serializes a valid PDF and downloads it in the browser, or writes it to disk in Node
steps.zh: 序列化成合法 PDF，浏览器里直接下载，Node 里写到磁盘

value.en: The PDF is produced where the data already is — no PDF server, no round-trip, data never leaves the browser
value.zh: PDF 在数据所在之处生成——不用 PDF 服务器、没有往返，数据不出浏览器

sources: https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF#usage (new jsPDF(), doc.text, doc.save; Node build saves to the working directory)
